parameters.command:
git add .claude/agents/orchestrator.md AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md start_services.sh telegram_bot/claude_api.py telegram_bot/main.py telegram_bot/metrics_aggregator.py telegram_bot/tasks.py telegram_bot/hooks_reader.py com.agentlab.monitoring.plist && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Enhance orchestrator with worker type selection and monitoring improvements

Worker Type Selection System:
- Added frontend_worker routing in orchestrator based on UI/UX keywords
- Extended BACKGROUND_TASK format to support worker_type specification
- Supports both legacy (2-part) and new (3-part) BACKGROUND_TASK formats
- Default worker_type is code_worker for backward compatibility
- Frontend triggers: "website", "UI", "design", "HTML", "CSS", "gallery", etc.

Task Management Enhancements:
- Added task activity logging with timestamps and output tracking
- Status command now shows latest activity per task with relative times
- Filter recent failed tasks to last hour only, exclude repetitive failures
- Added cleanup for stale pending tasks older than 1 hour
- Prevent "Find todos" and duplicate error spam in status

Execution Improvements:
- Added progress callbacks to log activity during task execution
- Send minimal user updates every 60 seconds (reduced from 30s)
- Pass worker_type as agent parameter to Claude session pool
- All input handlers now extract and use worker_type from background tasks

Monitoring Service:
- Changed start_services.sh - monitoring server now runs via launchd
- Removed manual monitoring server start/kill logic from restart command
- Added com.agentlab.monitoring.plist for launchd management

Documentation:
- Updated AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md with frontend_worker examples
- Added worker type selection guidelines in orchestrator.md
- Documented activity logging and status filtering behavior

Files Added:
- telegram_bot/hooks_reader.py - Hook configuration reader
- com.agentlab.monitoring.plist - Launchd config for monitoring service

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git add telegram_bot/hooks_reader.py telegram_bot/main.py telegram_bot/metrics_aggregator.py telegram_bot/tasks.py && git commit --amend --no-edit
